categories.main_business_segments: Huaneng International Power Co., Ltd. primarily operates in power generation, including coal-fired, gas-fired, hydroelectric, wind, solar, and biomass power plants. The company also engages in related services such as heat supply, port services, transportation, and integrated energy services. Its operations span domestic power generation in China and overseas investments in Singapore and Pakistan.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes modern technologies and equipment for power generation, including advanced ultra-supercritical coal-fired units, digital control systems, and innovative pollution control technologies such as low-temperature integrated pollutant removal and near-zero emission systems. It also invests in renewable energy technologies like offshore wind farms and photovoltaic power generation, and employs energy storage solutions including large-scale compressed air and molten salt thermal storage.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Huaneng International serves primarily provincial and local power grid operators in China, which account for over 80% of its external revenue. It also supplies electricity to commercial and residential customers in Singapore and Pakistan through its subsidiaries. The company’s markets include electricity and heat supply sectors, as well as related infrastructure services.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China, with power plants distributed in 26 provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities. It has wholly-owned subsidiaries in Singapore and investments in Pakistan. Its domestic operations cover a wide geographic area including key provinces such as Shandong, Jiangsu, Guangdong, and Liaoning.
categories.supply_chain_position: Huaneng International operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the power supply chain, focusing on power generation and energy services. It procures fuel such as coal and natural gas, manages power plant operations, and sells electricity and heat to grid operators and end users. It also engages in infrastructure development including ports and transportation related to fuel supply.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes green and low-carbon transformation, expanding renewable energy capacity, and enhancing energy storage technologies. It invests in R&D for advanced coal-fired technologies, pollution control, digitalization, and offshore wind power. Strategic priorities include optimizing energy structure, improving operational efficiency, and developing integrated energy solutions to support sustainable growth.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of electricity and heat to grid operators and end customers. Additional income comes from port services, transportation, leasing, and other energy-related services. The company also earns investment income from equity investments and financial instruments.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Huaneng International is one of the largest listed power generation companies in China and the first to be listed in New York, Hong Kong, and Shanghai. It holds a leading position in conventional and renewable energy sectors domestically. Its main competitors include other large state-owned power generation groups and regional power companies in China.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of December 31, 2024, the company had total assets of approximately RMB 595.6 billion and net assets attributable to shareholders of RMB 143.8 billion. It achieved operating revenue of RMB 245.6 billion in 2024, with a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 10.18 billion, representing a 21.86% increase year-over-year. The company’s controlled installed capacity reached 145,125 MW, with low-carbon energy accounting for 35.82%.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Huaneng International emphasizes reliable, sufficient, and environmentally friendly power supply, leveraging advanced technology and innovation to enhance efficiency and reduce emissions. Its competitive advantages include a diversified energy portfolio with significant renewable capacity, technological leadership in ultra-supercritical coal-fired units, and strong capital and operational capabilities supported by its parent company, China Huaneng Group.
